quotes.summary_phrase: LL Cool J on the full-circle moment of filming in his old neighborhood
quotes.excerpt: I literally filmed in my old neighborhood. That's an incredible feeling.
quotes.quote: It's a full-circle moment because I was in LA a long time, obviously exploring hip-hop culture all these years. Then I went to NCIS and we did 14 seasons in LA. Then it was like, what can we do different? What can we make happen? It felt like the right time to do New York. I literally filmed in my old neighborhood. That's an incredible feeling.

quotes.quote: I'm famous because I'm an artist. I'm not famous just to be famous. I'm an artist first. quotes.summary_phrase: LL Cool J on why stats don't tell the whole story in sports or music
quotes.excerpt: Stats don't tell you what's happening in the locker room, stats don't tell you how you affect other players.
quotes.quote: I can show you a bunch of stats, but stats don't tell you what's happening in the locker room, stats don't tell you how you affect other players around you, stats don't tell you how you make people feel, and that can lead to victories as well. In the arts, in music, you have artists that deserve to be heard, but if they have a higher kindling point, it's the record company's job to put a lighter under it until it's on fire.
